title: Can local text embeddings detect agent failures?
lines: Team G04 · NYCU Data Mining HW2
284 SWE-agent GPT-4 runs + 271 untouched Claude-3-Opus runs
MiniLM logs + CodeBERT patches, computed locally
Frozen encoders lose to simple numeric controls (BA 0.481 vs 0.657)
notes: Task-end failure screening on SWE-bench Lite. Zero new LLM API calls. Official execution verdicts define ground truth. Full author list and student IDs appear in the report.

title: The decision is whether a completed run needs review
lines: Normal reference: 54 officially resolved tasks (19.0%)
Failure label: 230 unresolved tasks (81.0%), including 17 silent failures (6.0%)
Errors, large patches and high cost do not prove failure
High failure prevalence limits classical rare-anomaly assumptions
notes: Category 4: Text / Logs. Task-end screening matches PR integration queues. We also isolate the rare 6.0% silent semantic failure subtype.

title: Training-only analysis shows overlapping behavior
lines: EDA uses outer fold 0 training rows only (32 normal, 138 failure)
Tokens received separates strongly (W = 0.999, KS = 0.520)
Exact redundancy (Spearman 1.000) removes duplicate tool-call count
Heavy right tails motivate log1p and normal-only median/IQR scaling
notes: No held-out row enters these boxplots or Wasserstein/KS statistics. Source: Paper/figures/v2/eda and v2_stats.tex.

title: Six-stage primary pipeline with frozen encoders
lines: MiniLM: 224-token log chunks, overlap 32, step + run mean pooling
CodeBERT: 480-token diff hunks, overlap 64, token-weighted pooling
Normal-only reference bank (~32 resolved runs per fold)
T2 score: mean dual cosine distance to k in {1,3,5} nearest normals
notes: Encoders remain frozen. Validation selects k and threshold tau under empirical FPR <= 20% maximizing recall.

title: Strict 5-fold CV plus untouched confirmatory holdout
lines: Primary: 5 stratified outer folds (N=284, ~60/20/20% train/val/test)
Confirmatory: 271 untouched SWE-agent Claude-3-Opus trajectories
Both zero-shot cross-agent transfer and locked 5-fold replication
Paired fold t-tests and 2,000-resample stratified paired bootstrap CIs
notes: Addresses prior test inspection on GPT-4 by evaluating frozen models once on the untouched 271 Claude-3-Opus holdout.

title: Numeric controls outperform the embedding detector
lines: Seed 42 OOF across 284 GPT-4 runs and 271 untouched Opus runs
Findings replicate on untouched Claude-3-Opus holdout (0.645 vs 0.542)
notes: All numbers derive from main_results.csv, bootstrap_ci.csv, and confirmatory_claude3opus_oof.csv.

title: The confusion matrices expose the missed failures
lines: T2: 179 of 230 failures receive no alert (recall 22.2%)
Only 40 of 219 unflagged T2 runs actually succeed (18.3%)
Conditional residual catches 47.1% of rare silent failures vs 0% for T1
notes: T2 TN 40 FP 14 FN 179 TP 51; ECOD TN 47 FP 7 FN 128 TP 102; Conditional TN 44 FP 10 FN 107 TP 123.

title: Mechanistic ablation: log variance drowns out patch signal
lines: Numeric kNN reaches 0.641 BA; CodeBERT patch-only reaches 0.594
Dual encoder drops to 0.481; MiniLM log-only is 0.456
CodeBERT anisotropy compresses patch distances (mean 0.009 vs log 0.143)
Log distance drives 98.2% of unweighted fusion variance
notes: Checked directly in embedding distance data: d_log variance is 56x larger than d_patch variance.

title: Contamination & threshold policy ablations
lines: Clean failure and normal dual distances overlap (0.077 vs 0.073)
10% contamination shifts failure scores by only -0.00014 (H3 refuted)
F2 and $-cost rules collapse to flagging 95-100% of runs under 81% skew
Always-alert ($15,000/mo) beats all detectors unless failure rate < 2.5%
notes: Threshold ablation table compares FPR<=20%, max-BA, max-F1, and max-F2/min-cost rules.

title: Error case studies and additive feature attribution
lines: FP django-13230 (s=.1128 > tau=.1087): 9 errors inflate d_log (.2029)
FN sympy-12454 (s=.0248 < tau=.0731): quiet 1-line edit looks normal
Boundary FP sympy-24213 (margin +.00018): 11-normal val step noise
ECOD additive tail attribution highlights patch size and stalled turns
notes: Full IDs, SHA-256s, raw feature values, and repository overlap counts are reported in Table 6 and Figure 5.

title: Takeaways, deployment limits, and next steps
lines: No method meets all four practical release gates on GPT-4 or Opus
Variance-standardized channel weighting and test-execution verification next
CPU extraction takes 3.15 s/run vs 0.012 ms/run for Inductive ECOD
All five member contributions remain pending confirmation
notes: Gates: recall>=90%, FPR<=20%, unflagged success>=80%, coverage>=5%. AI assistance and all five author IDs appear in the report.
